detection_objective: Repeated MFA denial/timeout pressure followed by a successful authentication for the same user and source IP.
rule_scope: All MFA failures, all successful sign-ins, or session-token theft by itself.
trigger_logic: Anchor on each successful authentication. Count denied/timeout MFA steps for the same user+source_ip in the preceding 15 minutes. Match when count >= 3.
mandatory_fields: event_time; user_name_or_alias; source_ip; event_outcome; event_action/category indicating MFA
strong_telemetry: session_id; correlation_id; request_id; device; country; Conditional Access/risk
response_action: Verify user approval, device, IP/ASN, Conditional Access, risk detections, and follow-on session activity.
test_status: v3 public regression + source-derived validation references

detection_objective: Suspicious scheduled-task persistence that launches SYSTEM PowerShell through a suspicious definition or a suspicious follow-on process/network chain.
rule_scope: All scheduled tasks or all SYSTEM PowerShell activity.
trigger_logic: Branch A: SYSTEM/ONLOGON PowerShell task definition with suspicious action context. Branch B: task launch -> SYSTEM PowerShell -> suspicious child/registry/network follow-on within correlation window.
mandatory_fields: event_time; host_name; task_name; execution account/integrity; process_name or task action
strong_telemetry: process_guid; parent_process_guid; command_line; child process; registry activity; network destination
confidence: High when branch B follow-on is present
response_action: Inspect task XML/action, creator, SYSTEM context, ProcessGuid lineage, dynamic compiler/LOLBIN children, registry and outbound connections.
test_status: v3 public regression + source-derived validation references

detection_objective: High-confidence SQL-injection attempts using either multi-rule/specialist WAF evidence in one transaction or an automated burst of SQLi-rule transactions.
rule_scope: Successful exploitation or backend compromise; those require server/application/database evidence.
trigger_logic: Branch A: a transaction has >=2 distinct SQLi rule IDs or a specialist SQLi rule. Branch B: >=20 distinct SQLi-rule transaction IDs for same source_ip+host in 5m.
alert_entity: HTTP transaction or source IP + host
strong_telemetry: path; method; payload location; WAF action; response status; backend request correlation
confidence: High for multi-rule; Medium-High for burst
response_action: Inspect raw/sanitised request, all WAF rule IDs in transaction, WAF enforcement disposition, backend/app/database evidence and source campaign scope.
test_status: v3 public regression + source-derived validation references

detection_objective: A newly added application/service-principal credential being used for a successful service-principal sign-in within 24 hours.
rule_scope: Credential creation alone, sign-in alone, or credential use outside the 24-hour lifecycle scope.
trigger_logic: Correlate credential-add and successful SP sign-in on BOTH service_principal_id and credential_key_id. Sign-in must occur after add and no later than +24h.
mandatory_fields: event_time; service_principal_id; credential_key_id; operation/event category; sign-in result
strong_telemetry: application_id; credential type; source_ip; resource; change_ticket; approved_context; owner
attack_mapping: Pending environment-specific review / intentionally not inherited
response_action: Validate credential type, owner/change ticket, source IP, resource, subsequent API activity, other credentials and containment actions.
test_status: v3 public regression + source-derived validation references

detection_objective: Addition of a member to a governed privileged security group using Windows group-membership audit events.
rule_scope: All account creation or all group changes; privilege scope is derived from a governed SID/object-ID inventory.
trigger_logic: Match 4728, 4732 or 4756-equivalent membership-addition event when enriched group identity is governed as privileged.
mandatory_fields: event_time; event_id; target/member; group_id or resolvable group identity; group_is_privileged
strong_telemetry: actor; actor_logon_id; host_name; event_record_id; corroborating process
confidence: High when stable group identity is present
response_action: Validate actor session, member identity, privileged-group SID/object ID, change approval, associated account creation and post-change activity.
test_status: v3 public regression + source-derived validation references

detection_objective: Structured chunked data transfer over DNS based on unique chunk indexes after exact-event deduplication.
rule_scope: Completed exfiltration by itself; completion and receiver reconstruction are forensic confidence/outcome evidence.
trigger_logic: Exact-dedup first. Parse transfer grammar. Group same source+destination/domain+transfer_object; match >=5 unique chunk indexes in 5m. Completion marker is enrichment only.
mandatory_fields: event_time; source_ip; destination identity; dns_query or parsed chunk_index; transfer_object
strong_telemetry: event_record_id; dns_transaction_id; dns_qr; frame_length; process; completion_marker; receiver/hash verification
response_action: Inspect process-to-network lineage, unique chunk sequence, domain/destination, volume, completion marker, receiver object and hash evidence.
test_status: v3 public regression + source-derived validation references
